column2: A man stole an ox and sold it.
A man took sheaves from the corner of a field at night.
A poor man gathered the gleanings in the field.
A man reaped the corner of his field.
An ox gored a man and the man died. The owner had been warned.
A man found a lost sheep on the road and kept it.
A man vowed a vow and did not pay it.
A thief broke into a house at night and the owner killed him.
A man kindled a fire and the fire consumed the stacks of grain of his neighbour.
A man ate bread without a blessing.
In Kyiv a man took a wallet from the pocket of another man.
A man carried a book in the street of Manhattan on the Sabbath inside an eruv.
After the seventh year a creditor who had written a prozbul demanded the debt.
On the Sabbath a gentile lit the fire for a Jew.
A man lent money to his neighbour and took interest under a heter iska.
The river froze in the winter.
